verdict.rationale: AI scheduling is a fair question for a calendar product, but the evidence pack never documents Google Calendar automatically placing tasks into time blocks or re-planning them when things change. The free/busy queries, push notifications, incremental sync and appointment booking pages are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the AI auto-scheduling capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change
